{{Quote|I need not wait for a starry night, nor tilt my gaze to seek the sky. For I have placed it at my back, in my hands, and upon my eyelids.|Mornye}}
{{Intro/Resonator|Mornye}} She is a researcher for the [[Spacetrek Collective]] and a professor for Exostrider Engineering at [[Startorch Academy]]. She was a student at Startorch Academy and an acquaintance of [[Rover]] 20 years before the [[Void Storm]] hit [[Lahai-Roi]]. With an unwavering dream to chart the course of humanity's exploration of the world beyond Solaris, she plays a key role in the technological developments of Lahai-Roi as a project head of the [[Spacetrek Collective Research Institute]].

==Trivia==
===Etymology===
* ''Mornië'' is the word for "darkness" in the fictional elvish language Quenya, from J.R.R. Tolkien's ''Lord of the Rings''.
* Alternatively, ''Molniya'' {{Lang|ru=Молния|lit=lightning}} is both the name of a series of Soviet/Russian satellites, and the name of the [[wp:Molniya orbit|highly elliptical orbit]] they were launched into.
